name.title: Name
name.description: Job name. It identifies the journey in charts, alerts and run history, so renaming starts a separate history.

script.title: Script
script.description: Playwright Test source code, in JavaScript or TypeScript. Set either this or `script_path`.

script_path.title: Script path
script_path.description: Absolute path to a Playwright Test file (.js, .ts, .mjs, .cjs, .mts or .cts) readable by the Netdata service account. Set either this or `script`.

secrets.title: Secrets
secrets.description: Credentials passed to the script as environment variables. Leave empty when the journey needs none.

name.title: Environment name
name.description: Environment variable name for the script, starting with `DEM_SECRET_` and followed by letters, digits or underscores. Names must be unique within the job.

value.title: Value
value.description: Secret value. Prefer a secret reference, such as `${env:WORKFLOW_PASSWORD}`, over a literal value.

screenshot_on_failure.title: Capture failure screenshot
screenshot_on_failure.description: Save a screenshot when a test fails. Screenshots can show sensitive page content.

trace_on_failure.title: Capture failure trace
trace_on_failure.description: Save a Playwright trace when a test fails; requires failure screenshots. Traces can contain passwords, cookies and request and response bodies.

browser_error_summary.title: Collect browser error summary
browser_error_summary.description: Count uncaught exceptions, console errors, failed requests and HTTP error responses during every run, with a few samples of each. Adds CPU and memory use on pages that log heavily.

update_every.title: Update every
update_every.description: How often to refresh the charts from the latest result, in seconds. Refreshing never starts a browser.

timeout.title: Timeout
timeout.description: Time limit for one run of the journey, in seconds. Time spent waiting for a free browser does not count.

check_every.title: Check every
check_every.description: How often to run the journey, in seconds.

vnode.ui:help: Charts of this job appear under the Virtual Node instead of this host. Define a static Virtual Node through `dem:vnode` or a YAML file in `vnodes/` under the Netdata configuration directory, then enter its reference name here. Leave empty to use the collecting Agent.

trace_on_failure.ui:help:
Recording runs during every run, including runs that pass, and adds CPU, memory and temporary disk use. Traces larger than 5 MiB are not kept.

Download a saved trace from the run's captures and open it with the Playwright Trace Viewer. Secrets are not masked inside traces.
